name: web-threads

frames.best_why: The whole web is drawn with the bright knot just left of centre and every strand readable.

tagline: Glowing violet threads weave to a bright knot on a dark stage.
summary: A full-bleed WebGL backdrop of thin luminous threads that cross, curve and gather at a glowing pinch point. The nearest thread brightens under the cursor, and clicks send a pulse of light along the web.
appearance: Six long lavender-white lines sweep across black, dipping and rising in loose waves and meeting at a small intensely bright point in the middle. A short headline sits at the top.
behaviour: The threads drift and their crossing point glides slowly across the stage. Hovering near a thread brightens it, and clicking sends a ripple of light travelling outward along the strands.
demo_content: Headline "Every signal, connected" and the line "Move across the threads, click to send a pulse."
search_phrases: click makes light travel along lines
use_when: A product or AI landing hero needs a dark, glowing network backdrop that responds to the pointer.
avoid_when: It is a constant WebGL loop needing a sized parent and adds little on a light or content-heavy page.
customise: Colours, thread count, speed, frequency, spread, pinch, nodes, glow, thickness, depth, pulses, intro, mouse strength and click pulse are props.
weight_why: A full-bleed fragment shader loops every frame over up to 24 glowing threads.

a11y.note: The canvas backdrop is pointer-only and unlabelled; there is nothing for assistive technology to use.

polish_why: Rich, believable glowing strands; the knot can sit close to the headline and pull focus.
title: Web Threads
